#### _**[Mitch McConnell's latest appearance is another disturbing reminder of how broken Washington has become. Politicians cling to power, their parties protect them, and the American people are left without the representation they deserve. At Endless Urgency, we're fighting to expose that dysfunction, hold both parties accountable, and push for the generational change our democracy desperately needs. This is exactly why independent media matters, especially right now. * * *
Hey folks,
What we're watching happen with Mitch McConnell is genuinely disturbing. And frankly, it's a perfect example of everything that's broken about Washington.
A sitting United States senator can't answer basic questions from reporters, his staff keeps pretending everything is fine, and the political establishment just looks the other way. This isn't just about Mitch McConnell. It's about a generation of politicians refusing to let go of power, even when the people they're supposed to represent are paying the price.
And it's time we had a serious conversation about it.
Here's what we're digging into:
* [**00:00:54**] Why Mitch McConnell's latest appearance raises serious questions about his ability to serve, and why America's gerontocracy problem can no longer be ignored.
* [**00:03:24**] The people of Kentucky deserve real representation. We break down the failures of accountability in both parties and why age limits, term limits, and transparency matter.
* [**00:06:27**] A generational shift is coming to Congress. We look at what the midterm elections mean for younger leadership and why Washington desperately needs new voices.
* [**00:09:34**] Democrats are beginning to confront their aging leadership problem, while Republicans remain stuck with Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell as the faces of their party.
* [**00:12:08**] It's time for generational change. Why both parties need to stop protecting politicians who refuse to step aside and start putting the American people first.

Look, this isn't about being cruel to older politicians. It's about dignity, accountability, and whether our democracy actually works for the people it's supposed to serve. We need leaders who are present, capable, and ready to fight for our future. And we need independent voices willing to say what Washington insiders won't. That's what we're building at Endless Urgency, and if you believe this country deserves better than the same broken political establishment, I hope you'll help us keep fighting.

With urgency,
--Mike

### What’s next for Jonny Larsen for Congress?
---
|
---
| | First, thank you to our supporters and voters. This process only works when candidates earn the trust of the public, and we're incredibly grateful to everyone who put their faith in Jonny and this campaign.
I'm happy to report that I've already updated my FEC Form 2 to reflect my **2028 run for Congress!**
The nationwide blue wave didn't skip Utah. There were several Democratic wins in the 4th Congressional District, including **Jess Birtcher** , who defeated anti-union Jordan Teuscher, and fellow veterans **Shana Anderson** in Senate District 19 and **Drew Howells** in House District 39. Many other Democrats also came remarkably close to victory, performing much better than predicted.
The entire state moved to the left, and we're optimistic that this progress will continue. Take a look below at how Jonny's share of the vote compares with previous Democratic candidates in today's 4th Congressional District. He outperformed every one of them, including candidates running in much more favorable election cycles. If this isn't a motivating factor, we'd like to know what is! Check out the graphic below.
**Stay involved!** We'll continue sending occasional campaign emails with events, updates, and opportunities to participate. Peter, just weeks
before Election Day, Donald Trump’s DHS agents raided Ilhan’s home in a
blatant attempt to intimidate her.

Now Trump’s administration is trying to strip Ilhan of the citizenship
she’s held for more than 25 years, using claims that have been debunked
again and again.

This is the latest escalation in Trump’s relentless revenge campaign
against Ilhan.

Why? Because Ilhan stands up for working people and refuses to back down.
In coming after her, Trump has put Ilhan, our Squad, and the people and
communities they love and represent in danger.

Trump’s playbook is simple: use fear to shut down progressive power. He’s
trying to make an example out of the Squad so no one else dares to speak
up.

But we know what this movement is made of, and we won’t be intimidated.
With threats this serious, security isn’t optional. It’s what lets our
Squad keep fighting in Congress.

We refuse to let Ilhan face these attacks alone, and we’re counting on
grassroots supporters like you to step up. We’re halfway through the
month, and we need to stay on pace to make sure the Squad has the security
they need to stay safe and unapologetically fearless in the halls of
Congress.

name: Tim Walz
subject: What comes next
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
Let’s stand with the folks we helped elect and give more working people a shot at making a difference.
#
Peter,
When we started Small Town PAC, we had a pretty simple idea: Find and support good people who know their communities, understand what their neighbors are up against, _and will fight like hell for them._
On Election Day, our candidates helped take back the House and won governors’ races across the country. They were part of a Democratic wave that sent Donald Trump a clear message: People want somebody looking out for them instead of billionaires.
**Peter, you helped these folks win. Now let’s make sure they have the support to take on the fights we elected them for.**
[**Will you chip in $5 or whatever works for you to help Small Town PAC support the folks we helped elect and find the next generation of Democratic leaders?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261115-1.2ZVrp7&amount=5&refcode=em20261115-1347&t=1&akid=1347%2E34582%2ES2MIb5)
We need more working people in office who know what it’s like to stretch a paycheck, worry about a medical bill, or wonder whether their kids can build a life in the town they grew up in. There are good people all over this country who could bring that experience to the job. We want to give them a shot.
And we’re going to keep standing with the folks we just helped elect because I know exactly what happens when you stand up to Donald Trump. When he turns his attacks on these new leaders, we need to have their backs.
**We’ve made real progress toward putting power back in the hands of our neighbors. But Trump and his billionaire buddies aren’t packing it in, so neither can we.**
[**Let’s stand behind our new leaders, defend our majorities, and bring more working people into this fight. Pitch in $5 today to help Small Town PAC keep building a Democratic Party that people know is on their side.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261115-1.2ZVrp7&amount=5&refcode=em20261115-1347&t=2&akid=1347%2E34582%2ES2MIb5)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261115-1.2ZVrp7&amount=5&refcode=20261115-1347&t=21&akid=1347%2E34582%2ES2MIb5)**
Let’s keep at it.
Tim

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20261115-1347-&t=22&refcode2=1347_34582_S2MIb5&akid=1347%2E34582%2ES2MIb5)**
---

| [](https://trk.emails.troydowning._)
---
Peter,
Do you believe in the power of prayer?
My name’s Troy Downing. When America faced its darkest hour after 9/11, I knew I couldn't just sit on the sidelines. I enlisted in the U.S. Air Force and served eight years in a Combat Search and Rescue squadron, deploying twice to Afghanistan.
On those missions, flying into danger to rescue wounded soldiers, you rely on something much bigger than yourself. Through every deployment and dark night, God’s guiding hand was our shield and protection.
Now, as a Member of Congress working to defend the American Dream and put Americans FIRST, the battlefield has changed, but the spiritual stakes are just as high. **I still rely on that same guiding hand every single day.**
[ If you believe in God and the power of prayer to guide our leaders and protect our land, I am humbly asking you to lend me your thoughts and prayers today.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._)
---

Your faith and your prayers are the greatest support I could ever ask for as we fight to keep our nation strong and free.
God Bless,
Troy Downing
U.S. Representative, Montana's 2nd District

Red tide reached bloom concentrations off Bay and Gulf counties this week, and suspected fish kills have been reported in both. Tallahassee, County Strike Tentative Deal Tallahassee Mayor-elect Jeremy Matlow and Leon County Commission Chair Christian Caban Thursday, aiming to end more than a year of feuding over fire fees. Caban called it a "generational public safety deal." The county would for about $525,000 each and lease them back to the city for $1. Fire fees would come off utility bills, and the county could request an audit at any time. The a provision cutting its work week from 53 hours to 42. Not everyone is sold. City Commissioner Dianne Williams-Cox told WCTV she hadn't seen the agreement and questioned its legal and financial implications. Researcher Max Epstein called the plan a good start but questioned the speed: "What's the rush here?" County commissioners meet Monday, and city commissioners take it up Wednesday. Red Tide Bloom Hits the Panhandle Red tide reached bloom concentrations off Bay and Gulf counties this week, and suspected fish kills have been reported in both. The in 20 Northwest Florida samples, from Escambia County to Gulf County. Four topped 100,000 cells per liter, the threshold for a bloom. Health officials issued warnings this week near and West Bay in Bay County, and near in Walton County. They advise people to stay out of the water there and not to harvest shellfish. Red tide can cause burning eyes, rashes, and breathing problems, especially for people with asthma or other lung conditions. Keep pets away from the water and dead fish. ## Tennessee Airports Affected by Ground Stop
Travelers at McGhee Tyson Airport [spent Friday evening deciding whether to wait, book a hotel, or try again Saturday](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtSAUhJ8GO4wgV64Fxd_Y3b_d0hzloGQRDJwruW-_cV9hm2lm8mVmvl7zC3zwcfsPBxoiN0esJSAR5tllxAjkL6SMWI5U6B3BuTTLTg5cCC4eM6x3YFbQWLNIMYJaGzRCj0qrbhS62c0yWulkr_sVNYKQz97Kcen0KJen0uvQeHMDhRAPIbpnr9oVOnCIUmiEYQTFVIfWU8ot7UgYI5aC6MInXZjbNR1NMDvRWVj_j8mJyanW2tYrUEsXk9ONZ3IS4hZ12zsQ_46pcnCEmd8zU6zeIt9yekfLC6WTW1_y-6TCKcOFgZ8BYuHHuu2InD4lRQ4-nykTk1OTjT2rD8GXQTPVbQf48FuO_vjsZeRPAAAA__-pYpAq) after the FAA halted departures nationwide for about five hours. The nation's top homeland security officials explained that the ground stop was due to [overloaded, outdated systems](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkTuupTAMQFcDXRD5QKBIMQ3dm3ZKZBKHGykkKPEFvd2PuDM7eJ1tHR3pyH--1i8IMaT9NxxoiPya8K4RibCsviAmoHAhFcR65ErvBN7nVfRiZJwzPqxgH2BV0DqzCT6Dsi0armelVT9z3b6MtaMUGkchRu9QofOSg_cDF1I6vtk2mEfIOR847yepOgs9eETBNcI4g2pUjy5QLh29kDAlrBXRx-98YelsPtpoXkRnbeSvRiyNWO777mK2EOUT9CCNWAruISeI7Kl6hkYsHh0WiAyu8DkycEdIoVL5t1b4rgxCOSMkZA5PKPQuWJmFxArW94HM5xjzHdL-X3wHh2wv-Z0cq5TPRixQKNiI6zRsEjQHJmB2bPCjYjBNmvlp1A7ctg1Kdi86YluMO-8QY6ijblS_HxDiJ5V--KfLiL8BAAD__yherdg) at regional air traffic control centers, and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there's no sign of a cyberattack. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed Congress for not approving more money for new technology and said he couldn't guarantee it won't happen again. Sen. Tammy Duckworth, D-Illinois, the top Democrat on the Senate's Aviation Subcommittee, [said the stop "will warrant a thorough and complete investigation."](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQBdCvMZ0jZnAgFC62ocu2W6LBjMFaY0f2kGj_fsUr3g-8ZqqjuVf3z3N-Uoghbb_pYCvi58SfGlmEy-wLcyIJb5bCXI9c5UzkfZ6xxV4DaLjP5C4wG2pWuyCMZFzDFobRDKYdYWh2S2PvmHo_dp77te0XfCwAaB7mDm7Brgn2eggAd4D20Zmbo5Y8M8LA1I9klGl5DZLLTXYWTolrZfbxX35zubl8NNHuIq-qul8KJ4XTN4o5_82nXEjhdOUonACu0ymcCr_OReHkifRW8pnWqilGfVbtY9h2qXo9WUvWFIqWQt4Hp11OUnLUodaTFU5NsevrE2IMtR-UabeDQvzqJT8c9W3xfwAAAP__q3mNbA) Closer to home, the Vols returned to their Knoxville facility before flying out late Friday for Saturday's game at Texas A&M. In Nashville, [six of BNA's 10 rental car companies sold out](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnDAYhJ_GdF7xew0chYs0dJc2Jfox48WSsU_2v1zy9hF5hbQzo9HM9-tz_eSYYn795BNOJKwZ3y1BBHUNFcgs8YJUoJ2lyTtzCGU1vRk1kaZhZX8HVsvd7jZDM1vfwdE028n2M03d4TwNNnwE_3wONHDwe9gwE807wjj2AV10dyERDUT9x9M-PPccAEMTeJzZKttjj1LqQw4IckZrQEh_yoX68OXskjtEvpp6_lBmUWYJ5TdNt6PMcl9SZknFc1Jm8QeXpn3JEvMbTbPoLbPmpiuycNKea9MNKenyFi2VLyTckq98bglain5B9FFOdNXtX98xpdjGSdn-dXJM_xbJf-K8nPkbAAD__1z-jiI) as stranded travelers hunted for another way home.
## Sagefield Breaks Ground in Thompson's Station
Simon Property Group [broke ground Thursday on Sagefield](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OhCAYxJ8GO4yw-K-guMZur73SfOKHkkMg8K1m3_7ivsI1k0xm8stkfp7zE5x3YfuGAzWRnQNexSMR5tlmxADkTqSMWI5Y6BXA2jjLRnZcCC7aGcxdmBVUq16kGEGZCrXoR9WrZhR9tWvVDiCxQzSdEcuqLAxqXKyxDSoYWlM5fQOFEK0QzfBQtYEGLKIUPUI3gmKqwdVRzDXtSBgCloJo_TuemGsTj8rrnSgV9vhicmJyuq6rvspx3iGT081nchLiFsnkVNwRA085Jsz05luOr8SXjPBbPiasvMCG1qFfedljSi5s3GAgzJz2eKQSQ-GFgFwMTE5V1mu6nPeudD1TzXaA859p9M9fTy3_AgAA___zD5C8), a 16-building shopping center where I-65 meets I-840 in Thompson's Station in Williamson County. The [100-acre project](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu5CAMRb8m6RgBIcOkoNgm3dt2y8gDJkFLTASeedq_XzG_8CrL1pHv1fnztX1Byon233CiY44b4XfLyIx1ixWRgNMbuSK2szR-EcRYNi31XSgl1LyB78BmYAzuqdUCxo_olF2MNXJRdjyctRL8bBdrn3qeJMx2thDBW4vT44HzmFx_qJSalZKPydw8SIiIWlmE-wJmMBJD4lJvfCAjEbaGGPO_8sZ68-UcszuYrzZMvwa9Dnr9TjknOFuhVl7VY4cGve61vCg8K8LfRLs4MAcRSxUNdoypbyCUlAJ8RdGOcl0dC4n6AAoCibEyJDqRWARsnLqiQiKR4KOcV48UjT_HQa9jdeH6tGl3Oxi5n5DypzL_0Pfb6f8BAAD__4vmmus) is set to open in late 2028, with about 60% of the land kept as green space. Sagefield will feature a mix of retail, chef-driven and farm-to-table restaurants, wellness, entertainment, hospitality, and community gathering spaces. Simon is also paying to widen Lewisburg Pike from two lanes to four between I-840 and Critz Lane. Traffic has been neighbors' biggest worry since the plan surfaced, and one resident [said earlier this year](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkbuupDAQRL8GskZ-YQ8BwSZkd9MNUWOawZIfyO4ZdP9-NVf7BxuWdFSqo_rztX5hiCE_f2OimflYM90tEjPV9ahEGTm8iStRS6XxK-NxlFUJZUFKkOOK_gOsBvt93pSc0PieZukm44yYpOvP2R9OPx67RrVZN5EaRyLatkmjxg2t7sP8KZRSjlKKhzaDR4EHkZKO0E5oOiNoD1zqwCcx5UytER3xu7ypDr6kPs4n89U6_atTS6eW-76HO8QYMLWST6oY9w_YqeVj2KklFo9x_Reu1xaDh5OwNmghlQxXLRdV_oZnLa8LSgYpBKCvBAljhJCBz5KuVjI0aIwcSu7UgpWDj7Tu2ispxg1GaxUY5yzgto-ghZPWH0Y5-xhOTrGv8379bG3WdUY8E4b4I8X_-ch7Vn8DAAD__53woto) that it "has gotten out of control." A neighbor at Thursday's groundbreaking also raised concerns about traffic and infrastructure. Simon, which also owns Opry Mills and the Mall at Green Hills, says the project will bring [millions in economic development](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkDFutTAQhE9jOhC7Ns9QuPgbuve3KdEG1g8rxkZ4A8rtI6LcIOVoRjOa7-05PSnEkF7_aWMn4qfEV4kswsfkD-ZEEk6Wg7lsuchnIu_zhC0-aoAauonmOzAZqhb3jjCQmSt2YAdjTTuArVan2XqN_bCgbTX22mjAzvSd9xZBD7oK7i4EgA6g7bVpZmrJMyNYpsdARpmWlyD5aGRl4ZS4FGYfv_LJRzPnrYpuFdmL0v8UjgrH67qa6-NIt6lwvF8pHGOeKda_Qta87SWnUhchCTnVhV7sA8elXvjkmPeNkygcq8Mt-xViDOVhlWlfG4X4Myt_ZHY6_A4AAP__KTmCyg), including more than $40 million in road, water, and sewer work. The center is expected to bring 700 jobs and generate $880 million a year in wages, sales tax, and local property tax. Shops and restaurants will be named later, with officials adding that a hotel, spa, and social club will also be on the property.
## 100,000 Native Trees up for Grabs
Tennesseans can now [reserve up to 10 native trees apiece](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ8GukEeY_4KijR0N21KNGtmFksGr-y5i_L2ERvlCdIeHR2d7_v1tX5RiOF8_qSDZ1VZT75KZFXOq2TmkzS8WTNzOVLR75NE0mqN7QERsFvJ34XVUb3ND4sTOV_zjMPkBmcmHOp97mjz0hnue5nIyCjy4FZaI34cuTWmDvM9iIgdohlb13gyJMwWB6Z-Ilc5w1vQlBvdWfk8uRRmib_Tm3Pj01HHeVd9lar9Udmlsst1XU1MnmJ7A92Vyi6fAO6gssueLvg3RWcBTyc8WeH7BZoADfxFhw87SMpw-6jsQlmDj7yK7x9i7ABdbw24qfUwIlnAbsOJJmcQbbPrEes8b68rxBhKP1TOPA8K8fNa_1P5e7Z_AgAA__-DH5ap) for pickup March 19-20, 2027, when the Tennessee Environmental Council hands out about 100,000 seedlings across all 95 counties. Choices include American beautyberry, American elderberry, American plum, Eastern redbud, flowering dogwood, red maple, pawpaw, shadblow serviceberry, shortleaf pine, and white oak. All are native to Tennessee and all will be bare-root seedlings 1 to 3 feet tall depending on the species. Orders are due online by March 1, and the council asks for [a donation of $3.99 to $9.99 per tree](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOiLGcXAoXNwmXW67JRrs42DJmMieEOXtV6y0T7Dt6Jvz93Wf7hxTzI__vMKKhCnjXRNEUKZQgMwSd0gB6rpVeWUOYZtUr4aOqKPLxO4AJs2tt7OikbVrYcmM2uh-JNMuVjnWTLMJioN3xvnx4gz3hs9-mAOubbSHIBFdiPrrWZ8c9xwARQY8jKwb3cNH2cpJFghyRq1ASJ9tRzm5bW2TXUSetTn_a9StUTdZkD7ZLfOrPCSuqAd13H-fu6NT5_nTFVSUnSVuuXZHkEbd2mL98x1TinUwje4fK8f0YyR_XGm36jsAAP__hwR_uQ). Last spring was the [first time every county hosted a pickup site](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLHuozAMxp8mbEFxCFCGDLew9dYbkQtOiRRClbjk-vandLgX-C-WJVs_fb_vz325ow8-Pn_jQZbZLZFKDsRMaXGJKCL7izgR5ePM_I7o3LlopQcJIKFfcK0Pi8Fmsw8NE5q1IQvjZEajJhib3W7dw3S3iR4KsXPOQO9GGKeBcBj6CVzjbQUCQA-gbp1pV1ToiDSMhMOERhhFm-cztbwTU4yUM5ELn_Oi1K7n0QS7M7-y6H4JPQs9l1Lako-rHoWeK1_oWek66vYfIqub3PAjE_E7xSy_csXzLjMjU_EbSfr7wpj9GYWem2S3V_Eh-DyMwqjngT58Q_APG7ys_hcAAP__DOCGEw). The trees come through the Tennessee Division of Forestry and local nurseries, and scholarships help people who can't afford the donation. The council started Tree Day in 2007 and more than 100,000 Tennesseans have planted over 1 million native trees across the state. Those trees help improve air quality, filter stormwater, support wildlife habitat, and strengthen Tennessee's tree canopy for generations to come.

## Kemp Extends Mountain Flood Emergency
Gov. Brian Kemp [extended the state of emergency](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyqzAQRb8GOjGsLIEpVLyGzq99JbMPrUATITHSxtj5-gxOJj-QZqs7e-85_27TDX3wcfmLGxle3BTpKIGYKU8upGRpo7xQnJ_0YIqW7EdKk2xlJwAE6GnPqew08wS1NZfWEqhrTQb6QfUKAHS9GqstXG1L_9EC9spaCRdARI1XkEp2tTfnxzMN59HNDK1zg5YDat0NfV-plqznlBteaaGUF48uPNOdcjOnrQ5mZd5LdflTybGS43EcjUsPjRwwMp6ZSo4nWyXHN9p28YVTRGFkEj-UQomYMq_iu0TM6T2ypyLQMWXxclLqbOx--BB86c5ty4Y-vIbwbyXejfwMAAD__3Cjikw) for Fannin, Gilmer, Murray, and Union counties through Nov. 19 as recovery from the record Nov. 5-6 flooding continues. Fannin County assessment teams have checked 1,012 structures so far. They count 38 homes and two businesses destroyed, with 169 homes and 78 businesses suffering major damage. County officials stressed the numbers are preliminary. Kemp said the extension keeps "all necessary resources" available. The Nov. 5-6 storms pushed the Toccoa River to a [record 18 feet](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrSAQQL8GOw0DolhQvMbuvnZLw8qgJAgGJ9e9-_UbbvYPtpnqZM6c-XgsDxtiSNt_e6ChzS8J7ysiEZbFx5wdHlg2TOsLvwiTQ_ed8yK4GFqAFtRylnyduNICjTOSO4ReN2hgnPqxBwDV7EarYdD-U3DUWnMpJ-u9dHIErqWWw9AEUzdWGupQ3Qrc-0mJySo1TOPIeo4uUC4d7bhhLluwPr7yE0u35qOJZic6Lyb_MTEzMd_33VmKNpGtQT6UiyrIxFxNTMwATMxcMTH7aK-9fceGtLUFz1wIXZtyob39lTExN8W48w4xhmuoB22HDfFtp79-7mnETwAAAP__-GuCZQ) in McCaysville and prompted [100 rescues](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkM2u2yAQhZ8G77AMF8f2gsVNWusueqO0i1TtxuJnwEjYWEDspk9fkVfoZjZnZnS-7-fn9Cmcd6u9igV4tmZa4UgecoY4GR-ChgWihVU94U-GVYP-G8JEG3rChGDSTlsMaQOVJ1Jp_tZoIKyvgJNuYB0jhLTVzA0DxXrVUyql6ajsG90IMpjetFJLoyrHy8eyTcpoa0UaY4aWDqJtT0PXIdaAdjnEOs9gIUTrhPHPsEOsVVgqz-ect4Te3hEdER2P46iPJPNeUkTHQoXo6IMSvsQiQ8TapfjYMmgcg9AJKx8SaLwoJZ5pd94DlmDdmnAE-XBeu9ViYcqpElmkHMM2O4VfnhAd38_f7_dv3eV6Hdnt9nH--Pr78uVy_vGLITpWkevtcN67dCo4dhHOv7rn__W-c_ovAAD__9OMmyw) across Fannin and Gilmer counties. One woman died. Officials have asked the public to pause general donations after an outpouring of support. The McCaysville donation center now needs only small propane heater bottles and carbon monoxide detectors.
## State Tax Collections Stall in October
Georgia's net tax collections [rose just 0.2% in October](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdKzwYMNSuEhDt2lTImOPjSXDIDPZnzx95Kv7Brf5qqNzRvPnsTxsyumIv-2OhmNYDnxdGZmxLCETedyxRDzcB9-Mh0f_j2iBDoZWylbq5Sx0neh4kY03fedRqnuDRo6TGpWUUjeb6VxQYEfUSq3aDSv0zq6D6vqhh7DexyaZaqy0rKNvTnYhTBomq_UwjaNQHfrEVG68YUQqMdmQP_TEcnO0N9lszOcl-l8CZgFzob9x88UGtpztwbZSAuaaETBLWUcJmL9dLdt36yhndJzouFpyTCsWAXNTjD9fKed0DfWOuNuUv6L804c9DfwPAAD__xrgf60) to $2.71 billion, after three straight months of gains between 2.3% and 3.5%. The biggest drag was individual income tax revenue, which fell $115.1 million, or 8.6%, to about $1.22 billion. Withholding payments dropped by the same percentage. Other categories grew, [according to Kemp's office](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAMgJ8mbFTYEGiGDP-Srf96I8olhkYKGAWXtvf0J073Brd4-vR9tj9u482nnNb5v1_IyjyNKz33TCJUxikzR1qozLSGN72E1kjxi3nEBvsaoAY9boX3jYKMUEXbNpGgu1ZkYTDd0AGAru620zoGA0OIfRx6gy2EvptMiKYbtLm2VbKn8aThHPoSoJkmo9F4rXszDKprKCbhcpE7zcRlTn7Kbz6oXAIvVbZ3kW1X7T-FTqE7fI68ixeO_n0SCt15WY0KXaE58arQnVGFDkCh-5XWHIQ_qdTiX3Whg9YH7fVjU-iqYuP2TDmnvT8Xmhef8k9d_vq5w-J3AAAA__87i4Jn). Corporate income tax collections jumped 48.7%, and gross sales tax collections rose 8.5%. Motor fuel tax revenue fell for a seventh straight month, down 4.3%, because Kemp has suspended the gas tax through Nov. 30. Kemp has raised the possibility of another special session. He said Nov. 4 that "budgetary issues" may need attention before lawmakers return in January.
## Zoox Robotaxis Roll into Atlanta
Amazon-owned Zoox has begun [testing driverless robotaxis](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uwzAMhU8jbzZMRfLPoKGLt3TtaCgS5QiQTUNm4ySnL1T0Bl3e9PA-8vu6zlcbU9yWT7ui4SXMG55HQmbMc0hEHlfMC27uhU_GzaN_E82ylV0NUIOe90zHjo5nqLy5tB5BDRUa6EfVKwDQ1d2MWobBO30D1w2dUjDabnAolb-FVvWuiqYsljaU0I2DNoRRy9Fq3Y19L1SLPjLlhu-4IOUl2pBe9MDcOFqrZO7M-yEuH0JOQk7neTaWk93YlodCzAeXopBTIQk5AZS4CDm9iZ51phuxfcajzpSKkJq-uf6bEHKqsvH7GVOKR1euWVYb0y-a_6vtYeRPAAAA__91yIJa) in northwest Atlanta, starting around Atlantic Station. The four-passenger vehicles were [built from the ground up](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAQhp8GO4yg6FpQXGO3115pEAYlQcfA3Lq7T3_hcm9wzRQzXybf_3_d57sJMRzrp9lB0-rnA64cgQjS7COigx3SCod9wZPgcODeiLNsZM-F4ELNZ8J8gqVZVE63jQPR3SrQYhi7oRNCqGrTY3fr_dgOrpEDNH5QUhhlhevs6G9L01ZBl4-FFmWo2orG-1HJ0SjVj8PAugZcIEw1bbACpjUYH1_4gFRb3KuoN6Izs_aDyYnJ6bqu2i65hCl3JidD0RxkmJzKksnpjfjkSwrHmnnCBck8Q-aE_I_kV6CNn99LDJan4CDzTCHGgljcgcmpStqdV4gx5L4orrsJ8deH_tvlQ8ufAAAA__9clovB) to carry riders, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. They join Waymo and May Mobility, which already run autonomous vehicles in the city. For now, only Zoox employees and their family and friends can ride. The company plans to open a public waitlist in the coming months and launch its early rider program in Atlanta in 2027. Zoox has been testing in Atlanta since spring 2025, mapping streets and studying local driving habits and weather. Service will expand to other parts of the city over the coming year.

Brian Kemp for Fannin, Gilmer, Murray, and Union counties through Nov. 19 as recovery from the record Nov. 5-6 flooding continues. Fannin County assessment teams have checked 1,012 structures so far. They count 38 homes and two businesses destroyed, with 169 homes and 78 businesses suffering major damage. County officials stressed the numbers are preliminary. Kemp said the extension keeps "all necessary resources" available. The Nov. 5-6 storms pushed the Toccoa River to a in McCaysville and prompted across Fannin and Gilmer counties. One woman died. Officials have asked the public to pause general donations after an outpouring of support. The McCaysville donation center now needs only small propane heater bottles and carbon monoxide detectors. State Tax Collections Stall in October Georgia's net tax collections to $2.71 billion, after three straight months of gains between 2.3% and 3.5%. The biggest drag was individual income tax revenue, which fell $115.1 million, or 8.6%, to about $1.22 billion. Withholding payments dropped by the same percentage. Other categories grew, . Corporate income tax collections jumped 48.7%, and gross sales tax collections rose 8.5%. Motor fuel tax revenue fell for a seventh straight month, down 4.3%, because Kemp has suspended the gas tax through Nov. 30. Kemp has raised the possibility of another special session. He said Nov. 4 that "budgetary issues" may need attention before lawmakers return in January. Zoox Robotaxis Roll into Atlanta Amazon-owned Zoox has begun in northwest Atlanta, starting around Atlantic Station. The four-passenger vehicles were to carry riders, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. They join Waymo and May Mobility, which already run autonomous vehicles in the city. For now, only Zoox employees and their family and friends can ride. The company plans to open a public waitlist in the coming months and launch its early rider program in Atlanta in 2027. ## Family Dollar Agrees to $63M Settlement
Chesapeake-based Family Dollar has agreed to a [proposed $63 million settlement](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMQL8mdEY4ZIEpKK6h22uvRJ5gmEghQbEXNH9_4vb-YEu7ePJ7_vM5f1KIIW2_aedRz3VOfElkVS7zSnuI7yXHSEW6dl-YoqdSwmwb2wEi4MdMXsPJs6NqGVdyTI-KR-wfrneIXVe9Rtf0a-eHZnBr6z0-7TA82DHjsx2eQ-uqMN48RPxAROtcjRZ907Pl5UHD03bGNbwEzaXWF5-hbCEFWuM7n1xqn_cqji_VQ0z7y9jJ2Om6rnpVX2_5NHa6lYBPTir_J2Ono7AIFI5MwvfivsHYCdHYaVUP2IMoKQsI-6_C0LWwhxhDTiCsGnnnpPAdCb4rgWguLHCU4Bm0UJKDCif_hisk8DnJ185FqjIux3XDpOuNa7adQvxnoj98wjnavwEAAP__Dfaevw) with the FTC and 17 states over allegations that it routinely charged shoppers more at checkout than advertised prices. Virginia did not join the case. Family Dollar, which is based in Chesapeake, operates more than [8,000 U.S. stores](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAMwPGngY0KmwBhyPAt3fqtNyKTOGApQBV8VH37E9dHuNGy9Jd__nqMD5Ik2_yfVnZ6xnHj15FYlfMYaZX0DntKlI-uWQNT8pSzjFhjVwFU0I7kVU4eDZXBRTJMQ8kO-sH0BqDrysW10wSTRWtbP_WRpqmtgRCsbSIxQl-Ku3oA0AIAGnMDBF_3jBwGshN2hak5iO75pgufkmfZhGJ67yfnm9_XMrlF9XkUzb8C7wXe6XkxrtU1ZBWfuMD7B1R9RFWQw-_fmx7VwaqJV960upJ-oTxzVfeEpu64sQ0z26GNMdBFgNBSBCizC8-XpCRH1xemnleS9HuO_vGTp8OfAAAA__-D8Yjn). A judge must approve the deal. If approved, shoppers who made eligible purchases from Jan. 1, 2023, to Oct. 1, 2026, may qualify for refunds from a [$40 million fund](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQBeDTmM6IMcaEwsU2dNl2SzSxh2Qk8yN7BMrtV2yOsN1II72n7_3cpzty4vX5jQt5OeZppbMkEqE8zbhwesctJczFtUskTAFz5sk0xmkADd2EQfigyWIV_YyWcKjIQz_Y3gI4V738YB3cYgfOtE0MCLGJt7ZzXYDh4fq-q9hfeQDQAYCxtgYDoenJUBzw9jBO2YYiy5ZredHB-ckr45ze20G5DttSJf8S2Ytqv5QZlRnP86zDo1yW66_MeJ3KjB-S_ph0kS1T0XvmQFoyrmXHTGt460IiiRZaRZmxyj7uJ6fExfXKNs8FOf31yj8nO7z5DQAA__9cdIHw). The total also includes a $20 million discount program offering 15% off select goods for two days, plus $3 million for the states, according to the [FTC's settlement terms](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMQL8mdEY4ZIEpKK6h22uvRJ5gmEghQbEXNH9_4vb-YEu7ePJ7_vM5f1KIIW2_aedRz3VOfElkVS7zSnuI7yXHSEW6dl-YoqdSwmwb2wEi4MdMXsPJs6NqGVdyTI-KR-wfrneIXVe9Rtf0a-eHZnBr6z0-7TA82DHjsx2eQ-uqMN48RPxAROtcjRZ907Pl5UHD03bGNbwEzaXWF5-hbCEFWuM7n1xqn_cqji_VQ0z7y9jJ2Om6rnpVX2_5NHa6lYBPTir_J2Ono7AIFI5MwvfivsHYCdHYaVUP2IMoKQsI-6_C0LWwhxhDTiCsGnnnpPAdCb4rgWguLHCU4Bm0UJKDCif_hisk8DnJ185FqjIux3XDpOuNa7adQvxnoj98wjnavwEAAP__Dfaevw).
## Bush Deployment Could Reach 12 Months

## Torch Sparks Rockefeller Building Fire
A demolition crew's torch sparked a fire Friday inside downtown Cleveland's [historic Rockefeller Building](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkD2P5CAMQH8N6Ygw-SApKK5JN9deGQExAzonRMBMdP_-lNVqtf2Wtp4sv_fnsT5MpHg8f5sddU3BrwdehbBWzGtO7i96JMLsY8ZiqObXUUpYpZAjB-AwrGdO5URXV2g23WMHfm5Qg5p71UM3jU3QaIzqTGemuesm4XG0KJxHq8QgUKFvor4PAsAAAKMcWyuUmGxvYR5nK3BmvcAt1pTbGjCFmDz9S2_MrUt7QzrUehbW_WJyYXK5rqu9LQZH-EYyx3ZjTC73ksmFkjPEP4cvhu9Yc2JyuVW5qTzEUlOOjn_LwO0r0haPZ5P1dl6RKJZRsV48dxPp45v644xvLf8HAAD___DVjBc), causing an estimated $150,000 in damage but no reported injuries. The sixth-floor blaze began during work in an elevator shaft, [sending flames through windows](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkL0O2zAMBp9G3hSIsuOfwUMWT03XjoYsUxFRRjIkJkbevkin7p0_4MPd_bqvd0dM6fHTPXGWHMOa8KyMIljWkv1vDMiMJVDB6ljKK9UaV2tsrwE0XNej5HqglxWafe6whTA1OMMwdUMH7dg3cZ6urTXoW7Bha4cRfYAujMbCGLZxG31D8_cQAK4A0Nv-spnBjFu3wdRPm8FJdQZ3klwuEjFHyoE_-Y3l4vOz4TmKHFW1N2UXZZfzPC_Pmr6bsgsm_arKLl8vZZcsEYuyiy94Vu28px2TOOaPrij666kl60hVciGv_2mgtxfxTumhKek9n0nymbRnfCO7tOscAnlyXHV1H2UXV_TtZmM2P46mzPtxEjPVflCdeTwd8V94-e_q79n-CQAA___9xpwF) and smoke across the Warehouse District. Crews battling the [second-alarm fire](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJyk0bvO2zAMBeCnkTcGouLr4KGLt79rR0MXKhZ-WQokJkLevnCHontngufgw_n1tX_pEEN6_NQnrZwPvydqNRIzlb1k-02eYqTiQ6GqI5dXqvXYlVQjIAIO-7Pk-iTLO3Zu7emOfuloxWnppx7v89gd64CT1LPVw6JnHOxsJ-fdMA39OKKRXnZhvQIRcUDEUY03Iyc5m97gMi5G0iJ6SS5wLjc-KB8h-_jJbyo3m88urgfzs4r7D6E2obbW2q19f-x1FGrThYONJNR20YTaYrY6CrXZSG-KOjmhtssHR6icS7DwDxzMK0QX0gNcbolzS_D3D6x-VXJgPuDozDFwyAl0NcSVcwVtNNNJiaHl8g1Xhw-Pg6lUqPoj1LYMYP2oLJEFryxBP9MdZnQOJmVosVJKZ5aurO7ZQoyhjpPo5ePUIf6x83-P9l7V7wAAAP__s32xNg) rigged an exterior pipe to supply water to upper floors because the vacant tower lacked a standpipe. K&D Group [bought the 1905 landmark](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMQL8GuqA4E2BSpLiGbq69EpngQDSGoCQzaP7-xOm02n5LW09Pfv7zGB8YOOzLb9zIlrj6caczM5VCaUzRPckTMyUfEmXkkl57zuuopOoEgIB2PFLMB7kyQj1bTTfwpiYLvdG9htu9q1eryUjdGyWd9mZGZ7R3vTMAKNvOg6mDvYQA0AJAp7pmkr28T3oC05lJkqm0pDmUmJqyUlxD9PyJb0qNi1vNdi3lyNXtV6WGSg3neTZXReuY3sS4zxdWqeFaVmrg6JDF_-EpZjG9Pll8wVl86xbTK_Ac9kWcoaziYNyz8DEJ1bcCD0xlo73kyyYOTM-LXDDhQnWy83EG5pC7vtJy2TDwv3vLjx_9tupvAAAA__9B05eY) in April for $5.13 million and plans to turn the building into roughly 275 apartments.
## Ohio Towns Ration Road Salt
Northeast Ohio communities plan to [ration road salt](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ_GZD3CxsNPQDAJ2V560ibIjJu1tcaN3D1rzdufuFfYqIKSSvV9fz_WDxdTzF9_3IGzUNjXjJUTimBZCz2_cceUsOyxILsk5ZWZw2pa04PWoO_rWYhPfMqqGz9b7PQ-NTjrYbKD1d3YN2HW3TiZwft-MFbb-2hM3zlv3DR2tvWbb-J8DWqt71rr3vS3rR3acbObnvppa3FStkUfhcpNAlKItKc3_WC5Pelo0hxETlbdQ5lFmaXWejs4X50yC2Z4sTLLxaXMQhKwXBkigVDNDMVJpAyFnIeLERzDQUUowxEzAoeXeKoZMAsWhp1eRQJUxG940nG6_AYW92bgmDCLMosr8HiYkD8_702Z_VljSpH7Qdn263Ax_f8tvxb-M5t_AQAA___q05lo) as Morton Salt’s Fairport Harbor mine enters its fourth week of a shutdown with no reopening date. The Ohio Department of Transportation said a 50,000-ton stockpile would fill about 30% of local orders, including just [379 of the 1,200 tons](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkb_uozAQhJ_GdBuxxgFcUFxD97v2SuQ_69iKg5G9Ccrbn7hXuGo0GumTPs2fn-3HpJz2x2_zooVLDNtOZ8vETHWrxT0pUM5UQ6rUTOb63luLm-zlCIiA9-2opR3keMPOL4oGDLqjBSetJoXDPHZxsfM8auvQB2dc6K21biY19VLR5Kwcu7RcQES8I-Iox5vtp362yqIete1JC9WTT1zqjSOVmErI3_KhenPl1eUlMh9NDL-EXIVcz_O8nc-vu0YhV1M5uUxCrpeakGsuzuSrlsqRTGO4iEKuV0AtxsOlCu19HPkLbJ7UICaGMxqGxODKO3t4kdnB1_Sh2uBMO1MVctV3wCngvXcEE84alPQaZhU0oDUyDGYw3uiuLv44U86pjZNQ_eNlUv5nw_99w2eRfwMAAP__zLee0A) Rootstown Township requested. South Russell’s replacement salt could push its bill above $260,000—more than two and a half times what was budgeted. Trumbull County plans to stretch its roughly 14,000 tons by [mixing salt with aggregate](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O5CAMQE9DOkbYIT8UFNvQzbZbRglxBrQkjoDMaG-_ylzhq_1kv-c_z-k5xxSP1-95J1s5bNNBn5KoVspTZv-XNkqJ8hYzlTnVfB2lhAkV9hJAQjedmctJvk7QrFZTC5tpyMJg9KChHfsmWAXj1sO4ar8Y6pRutWmRtAbqsDNqbqK9FwJABwA99o9FDWpc9AKmN4siI7SiNVbOjxqIQ-Qt_eM35YfnvUk21HoW0f4S6AS6r06-9rsEbkKg4yDQeU7XvlxFoLtnAt19VqADEOiU-XKRpefrqJGKzFROPlZZWd7xco8HSZ-4XJmabNfzE1OKpR-EVq99junrU3_8yLfF_wEAAP__pTGIag). A geologist warned that water could [dissolve salt and weaken](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOnTAQxvHTQGdkG9Y8Coo0dJs2JTJmjEdrPGg875HN6aONlBPsBT59_9-v9_XdY8Zy_PQnzEIprgXumkEEeGUKHxAhZ-CIDNVn4WepNa1WW6eMUeZtvZjqBUFW0-7zAL2JUwuzGadhHEz_cG2ahzgZ6AP0bnq44AYwNkQbot5Ah7CHFuevQWPMmzHGWddtetSPbdjM5KZNw9QMGnYU4k4SUEKK-ZNewF2gs81zErlq0_9o7NLY5b7vDnfwVRj82REfjV2gvJCpnFBEQQE-Phu7_M_QrrFLoGfe1e0FWGERflakonao4jfM-AdU9MgXsajkeSOu6ktEnVhAHUCZDqyi4PeVPZaqJIFirB-15Xm_bswZqxubQR-nx_zvuXyb_DXbvwEAAP__J_ycLg) the mine’s support pillars about 2,000 feet underground.
## Elder, Princeton Head to Paycor Stadium
Elder and unbeaten Princeton will meet Friday at [Paycor Stadium](https://email.editor.theohioflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunTAQRL8GOiPWcA0ULtLQvbQpkW3WeBXDWrYf6P59dFPkB9JMMSONjs6vr-3LUKTr-GlO1JWD3y58SsRaMW-Z3W_0GCNmTxmLiTV_X6WETfZSCQABry1lLgld3aDd9YgD-KVFDdMyTiMMs2qDlqgmaUdnZnSg7GxRDnYwSuJr3h34lvTnEABeAKCk6mw_9bMdLSxqsT0uzdjjTpVzVwNyIPbxzTfmzvHZRh1qTaUZfjRybeT6PE_3uMSfsZFrSZxraeQa6AiiuMAcxb9yp5sK8SVIeOZqTYwi40F8mSg8ffLiW8heVBYWRYrmjbswVSTzdpxFqWan77PNek8PxUhFTc3YH6eh-Bev_rfXW8s_AQAA__8lWpHi) for a Division I regional football title, the game’s second straight year at the Cincinnati Bengals’ home field. **Whatever happened to the View-Master?** A chance encounter at Oregon Caves in 1938 marked the unlikely beginning of a remarkable story. Harold Graves, who ran a Portland postcard company called Sawyer's, spotted a photographer named William Gruber shooting with two cameras taped together. A year later, [their invention](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK6jAYRp-m3UWaNE3bRRbei73IxUFUdFl-kz9txrSRJFPHtx_0FWb58cHhcC67fgfW2Xn4gAllMr6f8REdpoShN-4rIkQ_Qwh2wYgQ3BOUw54VTBBKCa16UMku2NNcS4PIsMxR0rrlNWesLfNRQnuFQmMlanUFowE1pwCGg1DaoChzK184SmlFaUlZuyq1UFRUBW-aRhnOMl6gtsmH1ae3cxrRuKdfMKyUn3Inx5TuMSvXGesy1t19HCcIt9eZsc7ZmOw8ZKw72znBgOQIjyeGSM7bzWW3Pp42B_Jv253Ifv33P_njvwknB0RH9qBukVD2XpGcfAJHBGiODRXAqooXdSGudcNqDnmQ-v6wztko6owXwwTWvf3S76oukv0EAAD__06Dios) debuted at the New York World's Fair. The magic of the View-Master was not only the 3D. It was the Kodachrome. You held the viewer up to a lamp, the film glowed from behind, and the colors came out richer than anything in a magazine. The eyepieces shut out the room. Then came that satisfying ka-chunk of the lever, and you were somewhere else. It was not a children's toy at first. The earliest reels were aimed at adults: the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Hawaii. The military bought 100,000 viewers to train troops during the war. Then Sawyer's picked up the Disney license, and everything changed. Mickey, Bambi, the Flintstones, the Apollo missions, _Star Wars,_ and more created a stereoscopic world for children. More than 1 billion reels were sold. Most families ended up with a shoebox of reels in the hall closet, and the design never budged, so every reel ever made still fits every viewer ever made. Eventually, video games ended the long View-Master run. The Beaverton plant closed in 2001, and the scenic reels stopped in 2008. But a [live-action View-Master movie](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpTAQhE8DmRFt_gMHm5C9TTdE_ezm0StjI7sHxO1HzBUmLZU-VX3_XssL2XP4_MWdjKxxCXRlTyKUltV_ZcIcA6bEJ2XC5G-0nhZd614BKOgWtMInLVA6sxJpakoyMEzt0Go9NeVmLDocxmHsgfToVmo7vTp49_Y9NYiOSjYPDgA6gAb0VDWut9B3dTuOo11bXbQ1OZaYqv-Rg2y0-juelCob99KbTeTIRfOn0HOh5-u6qmwTUXDI_n46hZ6fV4WedxQhrxyd5OPB4aNOpkvtmIWSQoeHoHAM6mLZVI7hVpQtHqQwCWd5GB1Mo-6gehLrqUzGHRd7z7kfirb-7Mj-Z5n8zudp9HcAAAD__0q-jaU) is reportedly in development at Sony. Of course, you can still buy a viewer, and you no longer have to settle for what the factory printed. [Several companies](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSqyAUxvGnwU5HDohaUNzGLrfd0jnCIbKLkAGik7ffSV5hm1_5fTP_r9t6Qx98vP_Hg3R1aY10lUC1Ul5deBbCkiLm7E8qhDm80ARaoQfVct7yYUVT_Ukrb6x2RECiIc3HWY4SYBbNroUdUA1oe4ebEm7atlFZNxlrRpwnpMbr9xznfOBccJg7YZXhaujlNE3GSWCyJ-tryt138rHu5MIrnZQ7k44m6L3WR2HiH4OFwbIlH-8fukiVwQI9DAyWXryRDJYDf6h9pWdu0xXb09PVHlgq5TYThdLt9QhN1vZx-RB8USOT_f1AHz5_9W-VTg2_AQAA___ex3wm) will turn seven of your own photos into a 3D reel that drops into any View-Master. A chance encounter at Oregon Caves in 1938 marked the unlikely beginning of a remarkable story. Harold Graves, who ran a Portland postcard company called Sawyer's, spotted a photographer named William Gruber shooting with two cameras taped together. A year later, debuted at the New York World's Fair. The magic of the View-Master was not only the 3D. It was the Kodachrome. You held the viewer up to a lamp, the film glowed from behind, and the colors came out richer than anything in a magazine. The eyepieces shut out the room. Then came that satisfying ka-chunk of the lever, and you were somewhere else. It was not a children's toy at first. The earliest reels were aimed at adults: the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Hawaii. The military bought 100,000 viewers to train troops during the war. Then Sawyer's picked up the Disney license, and everything changed. Mickey, Bambi, the Flintstones, the Apollo missions, Star Wars, and more created a stereoscopic world for children. More than 1 billion reels were sold. Most families ended up with a shoebox of reels in the hall closet, and the design never budged, so every reel ever made still fits every viewer ever made. Eventually, video games ended the long View-Master run. The Beaverton plant closed in 2001, and the scenic reels stopped in 2008. But a is reportedly in development at Sony. Of course, you can still buy a viewer, and you no longer have to settle for what the factory printed. will turn seven of your own photos into a 3D reel that drops into any View-Master. subject: Fighting to make sure America remembers
body:
The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget

The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
During World War II, when I passed another Black soldier, we didn't need to say a word. We just held up two fingers in a V.It stood for "Double Victory." Victory over fascism overseas, and victory over racism here at home.My name is Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse. I'm 99 years old, and I'm one of the last of the Tuskegee Airmen.I grew up in Roxbury, in Boston, in a family of preachers. After Pearl Harbor, my mother encouraged me to serve. So, in 1944, I graduated from English High School and enlisted at 17, along with about 20 of my classmates. My brother became one of the first Black Marines trained at Montford Point.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
I passed the exams for flight training. Then the Army ended the program before I could start. I went to officer school instead, and at 19, I was commissioned as a second lieutenant.**Friend, some of the hardest moments of my service had nothing to do with the enemy.** Once, traveling by train, a porter told me, "We don't ride that train," and I had to wait for the next one.At officer school in Texas, I waited 40 minutes for a table in the dining hall. When they finally seated me, it was behind a screen that walled me off from everyone else.I couldn't eat that steak. I just couldn't. For eight weeks, I lived on hot dogs, hamburgers, and milkshakes from the snack bar. But I didn't quit. I became a finance officer with the Tuskegee Airmen, which meant I was the paymaster. Back then, you didn't write checks. You paid in cash._I had the most important job on base. Everybody knew me._**And I served with the finest men I've known in my life, no matter their race.**
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
After the service, I went to Yale and then Boston University law school, and I practiced law for more than 40 years.In 2007, the Tuskegee Airmen received the Congressional Gold Medal, and the President of the United States saluted us to make up for all the salutes we never got. People sometimes call my story Black history. To me, it isn't. _It's American history. Our history._ And I've lived long enough to believe that somehow, somewhere, we Americans get our act together and do the right thing.**But only if we remember, Friend.** That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. This November, I joined AVC in Washington and shared my story with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen, the young men and women who will lead our military next.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
AVC recorded it, so it will be there long after I'm gone - and that's why I'm so passionate about AVC's work. _They make sure America never forgets the service and sacrifice of our veterans._ AVC is a nonprofit educational organization. Its mission is to preserve and promote the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes:
---
* **The National Memorial Day Parade** in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event
* **The Annual Veterans Conference** every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen
* **AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes,** a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide
* **Oral histories and documentaries** that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never forgotten

---
AVC is funded entirely by people like you, and every gift is tax-deductible. _**[Friend, will you join me with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give today, so the stories of every American who served are remembered and passed on to the next generation?](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)**_
---
[ **Yes, I'll Help America Remember the**
**Legacies of Our Veterans**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
I still hold up two fingers in a V now and then. These days, the victory I'm after is making sure America never forgets the men and women who served. _**[I hope you'll join me and AVC in securing that victory with your most generous gift today.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)**_
---
With gratitude, Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse II Lt. Colonel & original Tuskegee Airman On behalf of American Veterans Center

clean_body: The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget | | | | Friend, During World War II, when I passed another Black soldier, we didn't need to say a word. We just held up two fingers in a V.It stood for "Double Victory." Victory over fascism overseas, and victory over racism here at home.My name is Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse. I'm 99 years old, and I'm one of the last of the Tuskegee Airmen.I grew up in Roxbury, in Boston, in a family of preachers. After Pearl Harbor, my mother encouraged me to serve. So, in 1944, I graduated from English High School and enlisted at 17, along with about 20 of my classmates. My brother became one of the first Black Marines trained at Montford Point. I passed the exams for flight training. Then the Army ended the program before I could start. I went to officer school instead, and at 19, I was commissioned as a second lieutenant.Friend, some of the hardest moments of my service had nothing to do with the enemy. Once, traveling by train, a porter told me, "We don't ride that train," and I had to wait for the next one.At officer school in Texas, I waited 40 minutes for a table in the dining hall. When they finally seated me, it was behind a screen that walled me off from everyone else.I couldn't eat that steak. I just couldn't. For eight weeks, I lived on hot dogs, hamburgers, and milkshakes from the snack bar. But I didn't quit. I became a finance officer with the Tuskegee Airmen, which meant I was the paymaster. Back then, you didn't write checks. You paid in cash.I had the most important job on base. Everybody knew me.And I served with the finest men I've known in my life, no matter their race. After the service, I went to Yale and then Boston University law school, and I practiced law for more than 40 years.In 2007, the Tuskegee Airmen received the Congressional Gold Medal, and the President of the United States saluted us to make up for all the salutes we never got. People sometimes call my story Black history. To me, it isn't. It's American history. Our history. And I've lived long enough to believe that somehow, somewhere, we Americans get our act together and do the right thing.But only if we remember, Friend. That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. This November, I joined AVC in Washington and shared my story with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen, the young men and women who will lead our military next. AVC recorded it, so it will be there long after I'm gone - and that's why I'm so passionate about AVC's work. They make sure America never forgets the service and sacrifice of our veterans. AVC is a nonprofit educational organization. Its mission is to preserve and promote the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes: The National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event The Annual Veterans Conference every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes, a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide Oral histories and documentaries that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never forgotten AVC is funded entirely by people like you, and every gift is tax-deductible. I still hold up two fingers in a V now and then. These days, the victory I'm after is making sure America never forgets the men and women who served. With gratitude, Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse II Lt. Colonel & original Tuskegee Airman On behalf of American Veterans Center | | | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. Maybe someone in her life is pressuring her to have an abortion. But what if, before making that decision, she had the opportunity to see her baby for the very first time? **That's the life-changing opportunity your gift to PreBorn! can help provide.** Through our PreBorn! Network Clinics across America, mothers facing unexpected pregnancies receive free ultrasounds, compassionate care, and the opportunity to hear the gospel of Jesus Christ. When a mother sees her baby on the ultrasound screen and hears that tiny heartbeat, she has the opportunity to recognize the precious new life growing within her. **Your gift of just $28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound and shares the hope of the gospel with a mother considering abortion.** And as our thank-you for your gift of any amount, we'll send you PreBorn!'s beautiful new **2027**** _Celebrate the Beauty of New Life_****Calendar!**

## Weiser Names Transition Committee
Gov.-elect Phil Weiser named [more than 200 people](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkDvO2zAQhE8jdTS41IO_CxZp1DltSmFFLW0CfIG7tpHbB06QE_ztzGAw8_267TeMKZb7T8zkxIe90JsTiVDf3xSZuhDmZztRiL-01g0b7UabVQEoWPbWKzfyssN4uhCMx3UkB_Y629l-TTA-3LracHjrQZNGuC4nwgRLCFpbMItfx-g-hQCwwKSnBS6T0QfiMvvV24Aeh1nTGaX2izzI11Q7njWk3_VF_eJrHpN7iDQeph-D2QazCfP_2McfzPbvjMLWaizCKsTOojwesZCoTPmgzqpgJlbHk2MhZpUIz48sVUnHwlFiLcrXnKMI0WC2sbuzvWNKkVc7zPqeMaa_k-S7OF_O_AkAAP__Lq6OEg) to a transition committee that will recruit and recommend leaders for the state's cabinet departments. # _**[NATO Initiates Biggest Pivot In Decades To Fight Russia](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/228/71965/c97b1955b75883701b6191b47b2e1f77e06890b2/98be5d20b722cda87944591bb526e61f9a4ecdb0)**_

[](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/228/71965/c97b1955b75883701b6191b47b2e1f77e06890b2/98be5d20b722cda87944591bb526e61f9a4ecdb0)
---
For twenty years, NATO built itself to fight small wars far from home, the Afghanistans and the Kosovos. Now, for the first time in a generation, the alliance is rethinking that from the ground up, preparing instead for the one war it spent the post-Cold-War era assuming it would never have to fight: a direct, full-scale clash with Russia.

Hello Friend, Spiritual strength doesn't come in a single moment. It's built over time. And after more than 40 years of pastoring and preaching God's Word, I've learned that consistent time in Scripture is the key to a grounded, courageous life of faith. That's why I created the brand-new _**[2027 Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc1u3SAQhZ8G72wZBpubBYu27pW6SKVumiUiMOYimR8BpsrbV26TF8hupDlnPn2al2f1rP3ho_upA0rTvSpVWV9N6ljaAzGadBbtMGBsb4rNbB0pHemitGm-o-J6sNLYFdiAkoonLvhtATE8pAUQ7ImvFPZXrTVyuliA2y5mQRk1dvDyOkcpXSjQBdYJcd9hR7FafntdZiB8PrPVDetkUqxYur6YPsZ0TSlOJoXhkI_WciXwhbA7YfeK5iw45danVBxhdzYzMebWrR2dowTuNZ3FoDLJIoHt5ftXwtazBWV0yNq7SGCz2h9vymJPF0cf74n_TQJbLqlmNM1H974KaP0ZCGwYtP_ImxQbxkZg-yXGb79_jB_GQ5E2__HH4esqCJ_dVfqn0z75hS7Z3wAAAP__6HOZyw),**_ a weekday guide to help you start each day with biblical truth and encouragement. Every devotional in this 260-entry collection was written to help you think biblically, live obediently, and trust God more fully. Whether you're struggling with uncertainty, carrying the weight of past mistakes, or simply seeking God's direction, this resource is designed to meet you right where you are. You'll begin the year by discovering how to embrace the new beginning God offers. You'll turn your attention to Jesus Christ through Holy Week and a study of the end times. You'll follow the early church and see how the Holy Spirit empowered believers to stand firm in their faith. And you'll close the year examining the attitudes that shape your life, learning to find contentment and experiencing the freedom of forgiveness. These are not abstract ideas. They are time-tested truths drawn from over four decades of biblical teaching to help you walk closely with Christ each day. This beautifully produced 532-page devotional features a velvet red leather cover, rich gold and brown foil accents, and larger, easy-to-read print, making it both a meaningful spiritual investment and a joy to use.

I couldn't let this moment pass without personally thanking you, Peter.

I couldn't let this moment pass without personally thanking you, Peter.
| Peter: THANK [YOU! ](https://trk.email.exclusive-update._2vSSCyUQfQ)[Before anything else, thank you. ](https://trk.email.exclusive-update.-MxQ)We won. And I couldn't let this moment pass without personally thanking you, Peter. I wanted to express my deepest gratitude for your support, generous contributions, and for being the beacon of hope when times got dark. You were the backbone of my campaign and I know I can continue to rely on your support. I know just how much you've given, and I know it's a lot. But, I still need your help starting off on the right foot in Congress. [The fight has only just begun. ](https://trk.email.exclusive-update.)[Are you willing to help?](https://trk.email.exclusive-update._X7x1ZYwhTvPbfZNxed4Gg)
---
| [PITCH IN ONE LAST TIME HERE](https://trk.email.exclusive-update.)

As I prepare to step into office, I know the conversations we've had throughout this campaign are only the beginning. body:
We stand by our reporting – will you stand by us?

We stand by our reporting – will you stand by us?
| | | | Fellow Patriot,[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw) The minute I received a summons to appear in court on November 16th, I knew I had to write to you.**You see, my fellow journalist Cam Higby and I are facing TWO FELONY CHARGES in retaliation for exposing Minnesota’s weak, vulnerable election system.** If this Soros-funded prosecutor gets her way, we’re both headed to jail.And I need to know today... **[Will you stand by us as we fight these trumped-up charges?](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw) **
---
[ **STAND WITH JAMES** ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw)
---
My friend, you know the truth:
---
* These charges are an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism.
* These charges are an attempt to distract from what our reporting exposed as insecure elections in Minnesota.
* These charges are now the basis for a landmark 1st Amendment case where everyone’s right to speak truth to power is on the line.

---
Here’s what REALLY happened in Hennepin County.
---
* >> We never applied for a ballot.
* >> We talked to election clerks, asking questions and getting answers so that Americans could know what was really happening in the elections.
* >> We never signed an affidavit, procured a ballot, or even touched a ballot.

---
Even the Soros-funded prosecutor admitted we never intended to vote. So, where’s the crime? There is no crime. **This is about prosecuting and persecuting citizen journalists. It’s intimidation pure and simple.** Well my friend, I’m not backing down. **[And I need to know right away if you’ll help fight this fight as long as necessary... through whatever trial and appeals are necessary... all the way to the Supreme Court if needs be.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw)** Because a court battle like this takes resources. So I’m asking you to stand with us today.**[Please make your most generous contribution to the O’Keefe Media Group Foundation today to help fund our legal defense and stand up for the rights of independent journalists.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw)**

You may not know what a browser extension is, but you've probably used one. If you've ever used an ad blocker, congrats, you've used a browser extension! But they can do a lot more than that. iOS 27 now allows you to describe a (simple) browser extension, and Safari will create it for you!You can describe extensions that modify the appearance of a webpage (for instance, increase text size automatically), help you concentrate, translate text, and more.All you have to do is:
1. Open **Safari**.
2. Tap the **Page Menu icon** (it should either look like a puzzle piece above two horizontal lines or just the horizontal lines without the puzzle piece).
3. In the menu that appears, scroll down and tap **Describe Extension**.

**👥 On the ground:_After flipping the Texas House, the incoming legislators gather_ **
After Democrats flipped the Texas House, winning the chamber for the first time since the 2000 election, the incoming class of legislators gathered this week as they prepare to usher in a new era for Texans. [Together, they secured the largest net gain of seats for Texas House Democrats in modern history. ](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbuUDkNqsJ7xBvxHYd0kQe0aOR-kWSW06EI9pBZQboIu6VKlHVj3ckxreONMW5FTn__dB5i_QrUjE7-AO7QbNsruvBM5f8XrS46pfEI-3OSYZ8rKsWm0zU6MaoFpshUlTxwdr3V8es6YajyV25p1xDQWOZKxS1rcWUdjD5_9OvM-7cMGyeC2KO4QSmccovvQeyQgO37JwVcID5kokNaLdauN0sIqSFRjPXzi98ouTbx57223pTFzJ7Y1VVJfe-0vOYDdFxc-Yiamw2F1EkGNCHf0F6Tcc7fDl-fiTFHWldCHy1w2niSREQtZ1b0zzqmFZ5WOG2P7OTN0vciH2NIzl3dMcPovJIBfKog2DSKXLRgf6w2nzqPgsvP_OEtjACta665zOawmYGHMhwunQFdmkeyk1uNFJD58uP48Fk4aFTsHhof2gtEvSvapnmskDgDTkvILUuU_MA9GT8OH6isey2A_cG2mqZQVJMd5WxG7e3yPq_HZ94CICP9I6-Neosje4-ESVJ7S0g8jisOl0jU9qfgWtIqM9V77Ca_veeedGX4sqs_OcbAHNRAWr5UMKwyz1OvDTu62_EdFM5JnOfbykJKOiqeUXNgcKoZaFpZV1i0xSCRediSEagUYiRcs7SbINw/4vr/ggkniSsARHqvGmF5sOLZ3Q/h1/h001.P8By1-j5aCYyoRDoSNyAfUInXZJIT-_M2x-FKg6AGl4)

**🎊 Colorado:_"Our caucus is blue. This house is blue. My speaker is going to be Black."_ **
Last week, Colorado House Democrats elected Rep. Jennifer Bacon of Denver to serve as the next Speaker of the House. She will be the first Black woman to hold the position. Bacon will lead a Democratic supermajority in the 76th General Assembly, which will convene on Jan. 11. [Read more about history being made → ](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMUSRL5hUWNGnk36awU64yJRPbbjBRuuKc7frb0vh39v-PXVMAuwGp2zUXwKFGHa6-UUOyWWa9fNa6NMKD3w1UMDQU6U6TTtu6YB_7ADqy7w6LJcGcZsIheT_tAevGCPckec94bYOhwNxfg-4Y74g8c7YnQNpHAY3tw3INSQQAd4hihMqL66FYfKr8Qi7wQrVin30GYi7_g1gZVG-PIvCjwnCPbw9rfZBFpcNpD5u9r1aS36hHjHDnB2K5Jauk2R-cIX8F5ZaytXE2iqTUI7JZj-jTu_Noo_5Jbf0E976GxCL12HPRsISYZ2QtOebnmuQntkLiZrDIuolmcJBNEAmQsbNckAoU_8MIMtmuJc4zHGIKICVGFJufl0kTy3epQRe3Eym5K1KRcnVeH232kTU7DJwIUjCH7ZZ1-CLQodDTiV-ShrZk0LqS_Rns5E7UHyCRlcbyGhDJs69v0VqLGIshgoxXJlptSGd5UFiRyS2fASzi4QhYTXymI7mxGBxBUBH7I646JUHemCyY799XYBEN89Hults8Jm1DM58rEk9D5GNCREJX9up9_9NIlMax42qznjXgHDBJgH2zFme0qIvHw8UqolPYlD7BUqP9StmYtT_qXIX2wAaULXj7uILMl6nnZxo9sryhYwMGh6fPbute-g/4vr/ggkniSsARHqvGmF5sOLZ3Q/h3/h001.dNs0GjU5jGvo5QZzgYTpRZg9Y3YtU8jvt5AoFy_rd58)
**🎉 New Mexico:_Celebrating a Democratic Women majority_ **
Women in New Mexico won big this last election and now make up more than half of the state‘s lawmakers. Along with a woman-majority Legislature and a woman overseeing the state Senate, New Mexico women also hold positions such as governor, secretary of state, and a majority in the state’s supreme court. 53 percent of the seats in New Mexico’s legislature will be held by women, most of them Democrats. [Read more here → ](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtTIQJQ7VyRIVWRS9yxQD8MrYHQ72gBh0cVN9hrARNq6savoMhElXTdNaCkrfUZgapS0H2dSvo8nV4VeLI39kKkSpRNh00sUG7TcmQVfONqxf4sKLRyYqFE7bievGVaVNnX_XtzqneWFCTCK8mPWJAtUC70Wq8wMIhaS0yfg-k6M9SVTvhxUQPVevVaXxlIU9s1KUNEDmY_ur9bf4aqKLYxSQoYvDhsfnimLG9NKynUR7EgLRoow02ffTVq_E98vpMkwB7d_U6k1jiUPxAyRbJdCjiqbZOYUZl1I4E76DQ2eB0yR3u0HH78d7UQCw7uBQ46fplXXFuKuzrvhbQTxImz6D9ASnEsfDvOYqefKwxz4Tu84nN3Zw_5_GJI_ykOvkufXBShaX64IHwo_GJlb0xJk4qKJZIKkcUKIe8nRURy2nW6BbUm6FnF1hLiwu9pJ5KZza7eZResBruaRJAM1Q-Rkog_DtLGuGCzNeUG-Iw76_9_K5xAQyow4k8FcPisJbMw7qn4UfzNY1kEXFjYzIJBXIAsSvexPJzK6hVf7J_NMXfhFL7N2M4_1t5StgSARP-3LicwrffNvt0CPNsppTVVFUoTg1rx6GSnMQPWcvoHHFPZjSWYUINF8ysLfRho2z9w/4vr/ggkniSsARHqvGmF5sOLZ3Q/h4/h001.tPEove9IvVoaZxjB0n0YLOftaRbUS9N5SizWzi07s6c)
**🗳️ Preparing for the fight ahead:_Our work isn’t over_ **
This election isn’t over until every ballot is counted. There are still outstanding races across the country, and we have several high-stakes races where recounts, ballot challenges, and legal fights will determine outcomes. The DLCC is working directly with our in-state programs and partners to ensure that we win these final races. clean_body: Here's the latest edition of the DLCC's newsletter for Sunday, November 15th, 2026. | | | | | | 👥 On the ground:After flipping the Texas House, the incoming legislators gather After Democrats flipped the Texas House, winning the chamber for the first time since the 2000 election, the incoming class of legislators gathered this week as they prepare to usher in a new era for Texans. 🎊 Colorado:"Our caucus is blue. This house is blue. My speaker is going to be Black." Last week, Colorado House Democrats elected Rep. Jennifer Bacon of Denver to serve as the next Speaker of the House. She will be the first Black woman to hold the position. Bacon will lead a Democratic supermajority in the 76th General Assembly, which will convene on Jan. 11. 🎉 New Mexico:Celebrating a Democratic Women majority Women in New Mexico won big this last election and now make up more than half of the state‘s lawmakers. Along with a woman-majority Legislature and a woman overseeing the state Senate, New Mexico women also hold positions such as governor, secretary of state, and a majority in the state’s supreme court. 53 percent of the seats in New Mexico’s legislature will be held by women, most of them Democrats. 🗳️ Preparing for the fight ahead:Our work isn’t over This election isn’t over until every ballot is counted. There are still outstanding races across the country, and we have several high-stakes races where recounts, ballot challenges, and legal fights will determine outcomes. body:
#

Team , with one full month left in 2026, take a look at these the statistics from the Gun Violence Archive:
**11,200** gun involved deaths
**20,000** gun-involved injuries
**410** mass shootings
**530+** children killed or injured
**3000+** teenagers killed or injured
This is not okay. We have witnessed tragedy after tragedy, and yet too many lawmakers STILL refuse to acknowledge our gun violence crisis...much less address it.
But for the families affected — who wait for hours on end at the emergency room, who will have an empty seat at the dinner table for the rest of their lives — they can never, ever forget.
Gun violence is a uniquely American problem. We can’t give up in the fight to keep our country safe. While we have made progress in the movement to end gun violence, we still live in a nation where the threat of gun violence looms over us daily.
We must pass universal background checks at the federal level. We must make sure guns are safely stored. We must vote out extremist elected officials who put the gun lobby’s radical agenda above the safety of the people they are supposed to serve.
That is the mission we have at GIFFORDS. And that is why we are asking for your support.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/23704a88-0018-4231-881a-d2f60c71c803?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A recent news item caught my eye: A team of scientists at the [UK Atomic Energy Authority and the University of Bristol](https://substack.com/redirect/b4e7a8ac-a101-4a38-a93e-9f269d81cac2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) managed to build a battery out of nuclear waste and synthetic diamond that will be producing power through the year 7700. That's not a typo. The group successfully placed Carbon-14, the radioactive isotope extracted from retired nuclear reactor graphite, in a manufactured diamond to [capture the electrons from the carbon decay](https://substack.com/redirect/39735671-7a14-44f3-90c7-35044386c33e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the way a solar panel captures photons. As the diamond captures the radiation, it also produces a trickle of clean electricity that should flow for 5,700 years.
The irony is that nuclear waste, the bane of the last energy revolution, might actually fuel the next one. The UK alone has roughly [95,000 tonnes of irradiated graphite](https://substack.com/redirect/215c7836-8c8d-4c59-b388-b1a7ba36e5e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sitting in storage, waste from early reactors. It's classified as intermediate-level nuclear waste, costing taxpayers millions per year to babysit. That waste will remain radioactive for tens of thousands of years. Thinking of it as waste implies it's a long term liability. Thinking of it as fuel, however, turns it into an asset and potential revenue stream. The nuclear age's biggest headache has the potential to become its most elegant asset.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3088de9b-244a-4328-b5b7-1b0d63d6cdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now, before you dump all your energy stocks, it's worth thinking about the scale of this development. This battery produces **micro** watts, not megawatts. You're not charging a Tesla with it. You're not powering a grid. What you _are_ powering is a pacemaker that never needs replacing, a deep-sea sensor that outlasts the civilization that deployed it, a spacecraft transmitter that's still talking when Voyager 1's [plutonium runs dry around 2036](https://substack.com/redirect/39735671-7a14-44f3-90c7-35044386c33e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Swiss are working on a [parallel track](https://substack.com/redirect/e22d5569-6926-41c4-9e23-829dee9f73d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), solid-state crystalline electrolytes that could push conventional battery lifespans to 30 years with thousands of deep cycles. Between Zurich and Bristol, the entire concept of "battery life" is being reimagined...not _more_ power, but power that lasts _longer_.
And then there's fusion, at the other extreme. In December 2022, Lawrence Livermore's National Ignition Facility got [more energy out of a fusion reaction than its lasers put in](https://substack.com/redirect/a0ada204-0698-40e5-aff2-c3fa766a134a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a historic first. It has since [repeated the feat](https://substack.com/redirect/655f4096-d373-4196-96bd-23ee0c94684b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); a [record shot last year](https://substack.com/redirect/d8fd88f5-6d01-44c9-9403-528347d81dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) yielded roughly four times the energy delivered to the target. Private capital has noticed. Commonwealth Fusion Systems has [raised some $4 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/76c6f450-8755-4a64-9045-b35b6074a4b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and its SPARC machine is about 80% built, targeting net energy in 2027. Helion, which has a contract to sell fusion power to Microsoft, [hit 150 million degrees in February](https://substack.com/redirect/0978e5f7-ec43-45d7-a922-1393a74e876a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Pacific Fusion and dozens of others are also in the race. The old joke was that fusion is always 30 years away. Nobody's laughing now. Humanity appears well on the path to bottling the power of star.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/701bbb13-9df2-4804-9c58-2b00e4b0260c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What I find most thought-provoking are the implications of all of this. How would the world be different if energy was infinite and the problem of energy storage was truly solved?
I've spent the last several months writing about a series of crises that, on the surface, look unrelated. I wrote about how conflict in the Strait of Hormuz [took 20% of the world's LNG offline](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and left New England staring at $441-per-megawatt-hour electricity prices. I wrote about how [record diesel](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prices fed an inflation spiral that forced the Fed to hike instead of cut. I wrote about how that inflation, compounded by tariffs, produced the [voter rage that flipped both chambers of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and ended unified Republican government.
Every one of those crises traces back to the same root: energy dependence. Dependence on fossil fuels that move through chokepoints. Dependence on supply chains that can be severed by a single missile. Dependence on molecules that have to be drilled, shipped, refined, and burned, and that give the countries sitting on top of them leverage over everyone else.
* * *
## [The Oil Chokehold](https://substack.com/redirect/8625a339-3de3-48df-a078-d63dc26170ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| Mar 9
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8625a339-3de3-48df-a078-d63dc26170ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Most observers are analyzing the recent activities in Venezuela and the US-Israeli strikes against Iran as isolated acts. Proponents note the world is safer without Maduro, the world's leading supporter of narcoterrorism, and the IRGC, the world's largest exporter of terrorism (a sentiment with which I agree). Opponents suggest these actions were brazen violations of sovereignty and will destabilize the world.](https://substack.com/redirect/8625a339-3de3-48df-a078-d63dc26170ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/8625a339-3de3-48df-a078-d63dc26170ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Now imagine a different reality. If energy storage were solved (not in the microwatt sense of a diamond battery, but in the principle it represents: durable, decentralized, unchokeable power ), the entire problematic connection of energy to peach unravels. Hormuz becomes a shipping lane, not a geopolitical weapon. Diesel prices decouple from Middle Eastern wars. The Fed sets rates based on the economy, not on the price of crude. And the political rage that just reshaped Congress? It doesn't have the fuel (pun intended!) to ignite.
I'm not suggesting a carbon-14 diamond battery is going to do all that. It's a microwatt device in a lab in Bristol. But what it represents (the transformation of waste into power and in so doing removing the constraints of depletion) is trajectory that, followed far enough, dissolves the assumptions underneath every crisis I've written about this year.
* * *
## [VIDEO: Considering Climate Alarmism with Bjorn Lomborg](https://substack.com/redirect/5944731f-fa96-470e-b12f-e30a71282440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| May 28, 2021
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5944731f-fa96-470e-b12f-e30a71282440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5944731f-fa96-470e-b12f-e30a71282440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/5944731f-fa96-470e-b12f-e30a71282440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
It may also dissolve one more assumption. We've spent trillions on climate mitigation (subsidies, carbon taxes, mandates, net-zero pledges), all premised on clean energy staying scarce and expensive. What if it becomes abundant? Twenty-five years from now, will we look back on today's efforts as prudent insurance, or as stockpiling whale oil on the eve of kerosene? Will our grandchildren thank us for the sacrifice, or wonder why we rationed what was about to become abundant? Or is the promise of a miracle the most dangerous excuse to do nothing? Carbon already emitted doesn't care what we invent in 2040. With limitless energy, couldn't we simply pull it back out of the sky?
Energy is destiny. It always has been. Wars are fought over it. Elections are won and lost on its price. Empires have been relegated to the dustbin of history because of having or being denied energy. Entire economies rise and fall on who controls the spigot. A battery that lasts 5,700 years doesn't change that tomorrow. But it whispers something that the oil markets, the defense contractors, and the petrostates don't want to hear.
The spigot won't matter forever.
