# Siri App: How to Use Your iPhone's New AI App
If you have an iPhone 15 Pro or newer, after updating to iOS 27, you've probably noticed that Siri now has its own dedicated app. You can use Siri just like any other AI assistant now. Here's how to use the new Siri app.
## Why You’ll Love This Tip
* **Type to Siri in situations where you cannot speak aloud.**
* **Keep track of your conversations with the new Siri AI.**

## How to Use the New Siri App
### System Requirements
_This tip was performed on an iPhone 15 Pro running iOS 27. Find out how to update to the[latest version of iOS](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261067-8633485-a45851786f-0m1122fd64)._The Siri app on your iPhone keeps a record of any request or conversation you have with Siri, and you can go back and resume any conversation you want at any time. You can also use the app to type to Siri instead of speaking. To find out more ways to use Siri, be sure to sign up for our free [Tip of the Day](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261067-8633486-ce10d1da45-0m1122fd64) newsletter.Before you use the new Siri app, you may have to [join the Siri AI waitlist](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261067-8701065-9fa69b1210-0m1122fd64). Now, let's go over how to use the Siri AI app.
1. Open the **Siri app**.

|
---
2. If you're already in a conversation when you open the app, just tap the **back button** in the upper left corner. If not, proceed to step 3.

---
3. On the main page of the Siri app, you can tap the **new conversation icon** (it looks like a sheet of paper with a pencil) to start a new conversation with Siri.

---
### Enjoying Your Tip of the Day?
If you'd like to learn more about iPhone Life's premium paid subscription, [click here](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261067-3289577-73f10c1865-0m1122fd64)
4. You can tap the **search icon** to search your current conversations.

---
5. Tap the **menu icon** in the upper right (it looks like three horizontal lines) to sort your conversations.

---
6. List view is the default option. You can also sort conversations into a **Grid**.

---
7. In Grid view, you can tap the icon again to switch back to **List** view.

---
8. If you want to delete any conversations, tap **Select**.

---
9. Tap the **circle** next to a conversation to select it.

---
10. Tap the **delete icon** (it looks like a trashcan) to delete the conversation. Note: The Siri app does not ask for confirmation when deleting the conversations and there is no recently deleted folder, so be absolutely certain you want to delete the conversation before tapping the delete icon.

---
11. You can also **swipe left** on a conversation for extra options.

---
12. Tap the **pin icon** to pin a conversation, which moves it to the top of the list.

---
13. Tap the **delete icon** to delete it.

---

That's how to use the new Siri app on iPhone! Now, if you're ever in a situation where you can't speak aloud to Siri, you can just type instead using the app.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41647%2E3422442%2Eetkmpg)
Peter,
This year, we handed corporate PACs one of their biggest losses ever.
Ever since the _Citizens United_ decision opened the doors for nearly unlimited corporate spending in our elections, powerful special interests have poured millions into buying off politicians. **This year, their total spending reached an all-time high of over $730 million—a 60% increase from 2024.**
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261115_1_ak.-DrnIh&refcode=em20261115-41647&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41647%2E3422442%2Eetkmpg)
This spending was squarely meant to crush candidates fighting for working families—many of whom we endorsed on our 2026 slate, like Abdul El-Sayed and Sam Forstag. They knew our champions would stand up for everyday people instead of corporate profits, so they tried to buy their opponents a win—and their vote once in office.
**Our candidates won in huge numbers and proved that voters want leaders who will fight corporate power.**
Now, Democrats hold majorities in the House and Senate. They can stop disastrous bills from Donald Trump that give handouts to billionaires and conduct real oversight of companies ripping off people already struggling to get by.
This is what happens when organized people stand up to big money. When supporters like you chipped in as little as $5, it allowed us to back candidates who took on corporate interests. We know this is a winning strategy, and we’re ready to keep it going into the next election.

name: Chad Bianco
subject: Important. Please read.
body:
better days ahead

| | | | | |
---
| |

**A MESSAGE FROM SHERIFF CHAD BIANCO**

My fellow Californians,
I’ve spent the past couple of weeks reflecting on the devastating loss we experienced on November 3rd.
We watched a hostile takeover of California by a ruling class in Sacramento that has long forgotten the people it serves. They have mastered the art of managing our state’s decline, leaving countless Californians believing their voices no longer matter.That must change.
When Sacramento locked down your churches and businesses, I said no. When cities burned in 2020, I kept Riverside County safe.When fentanyl began killing our children, we went after the cartels, seized millions of pills, and put criminals behind bars. I became the first in the nation to arrest a fentanyl supplier for murder.
When politicians threatened your Second Amendment rights, we issued a record numbers of concealed carry permits. And we did it all while balancing our budget.
**I’ve delivered on my promises. I’ve stood up when others backed down. I’ve challenged the powerful when others looked away.**
And I’m just getting started.I hope you’ll join me in this glorious and righteous fight for California.

Thank you, and God bless,
**Sheriff Chad Bianco
Riverside County**

Since the election, the rest of the country has taken notice.
They've started paying attention to the Tejano singer who won a Trump +18 district by 25 points. _A 43-point swing._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e63f448-b8f5-4df5-b350-4941bcde5194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And everybody wants to know how we pulled it off.
I tell them that I didn't run on Team Red or Team Blue. I set my career aside -- over 30 years in Tejano music -- and reminded people at every event, from barbecues and town halls to quinceañeras, who I'm fighting for.
**I ran for Congress to give the people of South Texas hope.**
Now, we've won, and it's time we showed that our politics doesn't have to be bitter and destructive. It can actually deliver the changes we need.
**[Texas Republicans tried to gerrymander us. I think the size of our victory makes clear just how big a mistake that was. Check out this recap of our historic win:](https://substack.com/redirect/5e63f448-b8f5-4df5-b350-4941bcde5194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I'll talk to you soon,
Bobby

body:
| | |
---
Friend, we’re still celebrating Democrats’ historic election wins – and I couldn’t be more grateful for this team’s support.

But flipping the Senate is not the end of the fight – it’s the beginning of our mandate to get to work for you. Donald Trump is still in office, and we have big fights ahead.

**We’re going to work to bring down costs.** Americans have been squeezed at the grocery store, the pharmacy, and the gas pump. Folks are locked out of homeownership, and small businesses are doing everything right and still falling behind. We’re going to fight to put money back in your pockets.

**We’re going to work to restore healthcare access for millions.** No one in Nevada or anywhere else should have to choose between seeing a doctor and paying the bills. With a new Senate majority, we can start making care more affordable and more available.

**We’re going to work to hold the Trump administration accountable.** For too long, no one has asked the hard questions about corrupt, self-enriching deals made at the American people’s expense. That’s about to change. It’s time for real accountability.

This work won’t be easy. There are many fights ahead of us, and Republicans and their allies aren’t going anywhere. [**_But as we’ve seen over the past few weeks, when we all work together, we’re unstoppable. So will you pitch in $5 today to help power the work ahead?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143504072/660434023/1159685984?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5976-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWM5ODA3Yi0yN2UxLWYxMTEtOTFmMC0wMDBkM2ExOGUyNDQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IEbYm4UnpqvVaDtLZ15i98TbrL3nTJdT0TFRMKy3V9I=)

Thanks for helping us keep up the momentum. I’m so grateful to have you on this team.

Thank you,

Jacky
|

| **A note from Sen. Jacky Rosen:**

Friend, because of grassroots supporters like you, we flipped the Senate. Now, the real work begins.

Donald Trump is still in the White House, so we have our work cut out for us. I’m fighting every day to deliver progress for people across Nevada and our country, and I need your continued support to protect what we’ve won and keep up the fights that matter most.

**[Will you chip in now to help power what comes next?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143504073/660434024/616501713?refcode=footer&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWM5ODA3Yi0yN2UxLWYxMTEtOTFmMC0wMDBkM2ExOGUyNDQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IEbYm4UnpqvVaDtLZ15i98TbrL3nTJdT0TFRMKy3V9I=)** You can also **[text JACKY to 30508](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143504074/660434025/616501713?refcode=footer&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWM5ODA3Yi0yN2UxLWYxMTEtOTFmMC0wMDBkM2ExOGUyNDQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IEbYm4UnpqvVaDtLZ15i98TbrL3nTJdT0TFRMKy3V9I=)** to become a core member of our team and get exclusive updates from my campaign.

name: Steve Roberts, Save Election Day
subject: Election Day shouldn’t last a month
body:
Millions of ballots were still uncounted days after the polls closed. Enough is enough.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
I'm tired of waiting, and I'd bet you are too. Millions of Americans went to bed on Election Night without knowing who won their races. A week later, plenty of them still don't know, **because ballots are still trickling into county offices in California, Alaska, Washington, and elsewhere.** Every one of those late ballots still gets counted. _California is the worst of it._ The state let mail ballots roll in for a full week after the polls closed. Two days after Election Day, its own officials admitted more than **4.8 million ballots were still sitting unprocessed.** _(That 's more than the populations of 26 states!)_ And those counties don't have to finish until December 4th. _December!_ Alaska keeps the door open for **10 days** after the election. Washington keeps it open for **20 days!** You did your part. You showed up, cast your ballot and waited for answers that never came. Meanwhile, 14 states treat Election Day like the start of a countdown, counting ballots that show up days or even _weeks_ after the polls close. **_It 's maddening_**, and it does nothing to build trust in the result.**Election Day shouldn 't turn into Election Month. I've had enough of being told this is normal.**Here at Save Election Day, we're a 501(c)(4) nonprofit led by election lawyers who have worked Election Nights and recounts ourselves.We've watched the counts drag on from the inside, and we started Save Election Day to carry critical election reforms into the states, because that's where elections are run. **[Will you make a generous donation of $25 today to help us end the nonsensical practices that create opportunities for fraud and distrust in our elections?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckb2O3DAMhJ9G7mxYkn_WhYsAiwVSXBAgRUqBJ1G7RPTjiPIe7u0DJbkXuHa-AWdI_nwxL0CB0v0bRNyJ2RQ2GNBWysnBOz_yGVyqAbhCNGpUSy9lL2cDttITzQSd22clL_7S4S7XbVpXuam5e-zu1a8StYfZe21hg2nc3MWiB7VJNcmO9jZPSjnLbZqVHqybJ78ul8WNGywexTSeh4OKAyUmh2xzPo4cqJLlIZd7F_ZHrQcL_UWom1A3RnsWHN4oFXSDzbFp8MT-Y6fewbtQN8D-FULIlXuwv4W-nTWaiI7OKPQVI1AQamki57NYFPr6gOKAf5nm_4csxAPonoS-MjqT8rPBk5ha0t9jfThzqpiq0NevP77LRY-b_E8qlpbYld0dbxQC8bKKaby3Bq1_Vz_5leeu_gQAAP__mSChZQ)**
---
| | | [ **HELP US SAVE OUR ELECTIONS**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckb2O3DAMhJ9G7mxYkn_WhYsAiwVSXBAgRUqBJ1G7RPTjiPIe7u0DJbkXuHa-AWdI_nwxL0CB0v0bRNyJ2RQ2GNBWysnBOz_yGVyqAbhCNGpUSy9lL2cDttITzQSd22clL_7S4S7XbVpXuam5e-zu1a8StYfZe21hg2nc3MWiB7VJNcmO9jZPSjnLbZqVHqybJ78ul8WNGywexTSeh4OKAyUmh2xzPo4cqJLlIZd7F_ZHrQcL_UWom1A3RnsWHN4oFXSDzbFp8MT-Y6fewbtQN8D-FULIlXuwv4W-nTWaiI7OKPQVI1AQamki57NYFPr6gOKAf5nm_4csxAPonoS-MjqT8rPBk5ha0t9jfThzqpiq0NevP77LRY-b_E8qlpbYld0dbxQC8bKKaby3Bq1_Vz_5leeu_gQAAP__mSChZQ)
---
This summer, the Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that states can keep counting ballots that arrive after Election Day. _I won 't pretend that didn't sting._ But the ruling also told us exactly where this fight gets won: in the states, one law at a time.**Our mission is to bring back Election Day by passing state laws that:**
---
* End the counting of ballots that arrive after Election Day
* Require photo voter ID
* Set one national Election Day
* Shorten mail-in and early voting windows
* Make sure only citizens vote in American elections

---
We write the bills and work with state lawmakers to pass them. When a legislature refuses to act, we take the fight straight to the voters with ballot measures.Most state legislatures go back into session early next year. That's our best shot at changing these laws before 2028, and we can't do it without people like you.**[Will you make a generous gift today to help us bring back Election Day and restore trust in our elections?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckb2O3DAMhJ9G7mxYkn_WhYsAiwVSXBAgRUqBJ1G7RPTjiPIe7u0DJbkXuHa-AWdI_nwxL0CB0v0bRNyJ2RQ2GNBWysnBOz_yGVyqAbhCNGpUSy9lL2cDttITzQSd22clL_7S4S7XbVpXuam5e-zu1a8StYfZe21hg2nc3MWiB7VJNcmO9jZPSjnLbZqVHqybJ78ul8WNGywexTSeh4OKAyUmh2xzPo4cqJLlIZd7F_ZHrQcL_UWom1A3RnsWHN4oFXSDzbFp8MT-Y6fewbtQN8D-FULIlXuwv4W-nTWaiI7OKPQVI1AQamki57NYFPr6gOKAf5nm_4csxAPonoS-MjqT8rPBk5ha0t9jfThzqpiq0NevP77LRY-b_E8qlpbYld0dbxQC8bKKaby3Bq1_Vz_5leeu_gQAAP__mSChZQ)**
---
[ **HELP BRING BACK ELECTION DAY!**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckb2O3DAMhJ9G7mxYkn_WhYsAiwVSXBAgRUqBJ1G7RPTjiPIe7u0DJbkXuHa-AWdI_nwxL0CB0v0bRNyJ2RQ2GNBWysnBOz_yGVyqAbhCNGpUSy9lL2cDttITzQSd22clL_7S4S7XbVpXuam5e-zu1a8StYfZe21hg2nc3MWiB7VJNcmO9jZPSjnLbZqVHqybJ78ul8WNGywexTSeh4OKAyUmh2xzPo4cqJLlIZd7F_ZHrQcL_UWom1A3RnsWHN4oFXSDzbFp8MT-Y6fewbtQN8D-FULIlXuwv4W-nTWaiI7OKPQVI1AQamki57NYFPr6gOKAf5nm_4csxAPonoS-MjqT8rPBk5ha0t9jfThzqpiq0NevP77LRY-b_E8qlpbYld0dbxQC8bKKaby3Bq1_Vz_5leeu_gQAAP__mSChZQ)
---
Thank you for standing with us.**Steve Roberts**
COO, General Counsel
Save Election Day

body:

Team,
Tonight at midnight, our mid-month fundraising deadline comes to a close, and it's the first one since Election Day.
After everything we put into this campaign, it would be easy to take a long break. But when I look at what we accomplished together, I don't want to let that energy go. I want to build on it.

The Sunday after the election, I sat in a church that said nothing about it. It was like going to church in Bangor the week the Paul Bunyan statue came to life and started running around, and nobody said a word. Travis and I started there, with the Republican bloodbath in Maine and a consulting class that gets paid whether the party wins or loses. From there we got into the worldview gap among millennials and Gen Z, Charlie Kirk and the young people who have learned to keep quiet, the HIV and hepatitis C outbreak among needle exchange clients in Penobscot County, and the Lewiston City Hall early-voting footage The Maine Wire obtained through a public records request. Travis took us through Exodus and the new king who had forgotten Joseph. Near the end I asked why so many young women have moved away from conservatives. That one is for the next episode.

Folks, it’s Lisa Blunt Rochester. My great-great-great-grandfather was enslaved. After the Civil War, he signed a document finally granting him the right to vote. He signed with an "X" because he had never been taught to read or write. I keep his struggles in mind as I serve the people of Delaware. My ancestors fought hard for their rights – and now I’m fighting hard in the Senate to ensure those rights are protected. I’m committed to defending voting rights, Medicaid and healthcare access, and other fundamental freedoms from the threat of far-right extremists. **I won’t let Republicans in the Senate roll back our hard-earned rights.** But my fight takes a _lot_ of resources, folks – and I need your help so I can keep defending our liberties in the Senate. **Folks, Black women only raise on average _one-third_ of what their white counterparts do when fundraising! But with our rights on the line, we can’t afford to be part of that bleak statistic.** [**_Will you help ensure that I have the resources needed to keep taking on the Trump administration to protect our freedoms and our democracy? I produced the movie Sound of Freedom. I'm so glad I found you. Because the movie told one story. And there are so many more children waiting to be found. Children like a young girl we'll call Kristen. For months, she was locked in an attic. No windows. No escape. Sold again and again. Until one day, she heard the sound of freedom. She knocked on a hotel room door. She expected to find the person her trafficker had sent her to meet. But when the door opened, Freedom Strike Force -- a rescue team we equip -- was waiting. She is safe today because someone cared enough to act. Sound of Freedom became the #1 movie in America. It was viewed by over 10 million people at the box office and even exceeded Indiana Jones and Mission: Impossible. Mel Gibson, Tony Robbins, Dana White, Lauren Daigle, Jewel, and Alejandro Monteverde have been honored as Ambassadors of Freedom for their role in making the movie so impactful. President Trump stood with me at the premiere. But the movie was only the beginning. I made a promise to God to dedicate my life to ending child trafficking. That promise became Sound of Freedom Foundation. ✅ We help strengthen struggling families before traffickers can target their children. ✅ We equip trusted partners working to rescue exploited children. ✅ We educate parents and communities about the warning signs predators use. ✅ We advocate for stronger laws to protect innocent lives. What if it were your child? I could not walk away. I don't believe you can either. Right now, to honor President Trump's unwavering commitment to rescuing enslaved children, our Board of Directors has established the Donald J. Trump Matching Challenge Fund. Your first gift will double its impact. ✅ $25 becomes $50 ✅ $50 becomes $100 ✅ $100 becomes $200 "Let the little children come to me ... for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14, NIV) Every child is created by God with dignity. God 's children are not for sale.With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom , Producer For Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Somewhere tonight, a child is crying out where no one can hear her. Your gift will be DOUBLED to help rescue her, but only until midnight on November 25. Please don't wait. | Sound of Freedom Foundation is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. All donations are tax deductible as permissible by law and used where needed most. MAGA groups spent more than $8 million trying to keep me out of Congress.
They flooded Hampton Roads with attack ads and mailers, all to protect Jen Kiggans. They knew this was one of the seats that would decide the House, and they spent like it.
We had two choices: play it safe and hope it was enough, or pull out all the stops to match their firepower.
We pulled out all the stops.
We answered every attack. We stayed on the air, kept our organizers in the field, and made sure voters across Hampton Roads heard the truth about this race.
But matching $8 million in MAGA money came at a steep cost. Our campaign finished this race financially underwater.
Unlike the GOP, I don’t have a million-dollar war chest from billionaires like Elon Musk. I need to close out this campaign the same way I ran it: with small-dollar contributions from patriots like you.

Democratic turnout was off the charts, Derek!
From Austin to Madison to Columbus, the American people showed up to the polls to tell Trump that our elections cannot be bought.
Trump’s MAGA extremism has been a disaster for America, and because of supporters like you, Democrats like David Crowley beat their billionaire-backed opponents and are heading to office in January.
Voter turnout was up this year, and Democrats must keep up this enthusiasm and show up to vote every single year so we can keep winning.

subject: ICE got a blank check. We got the bill.
body:
The private prison companies are already counting on it. | | | Peter, The day after the midterm elections, the head of the Department of Homeland Security posted a three-word message: _"Deportations will continue."_ 1 That same day, CoreCivic, one of the two largest private prison companies running ICE detention, took a call with investors. The message: ICE's funding is locked in, enforcement is ramping back up, and they're encouraging the agency to buy more detention centers quickly.1 **[They say deportations will continue. So will our organizing. Chip in $15 right now to power the movement for citizenship.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeTut42zbwkHK0DM6Y89EfsG_DjR4Q2jRQE9Qu2azTDb1fneAYIfmk8UwwrILnrXoHoYolsEwiHIJw05ZhzOtVvfnhUsNbUioCWJoH0d3NIo388y48Biuc-lYXfFyd0zCxifkf-3dGovRL-_OvApAH_5pOvdQvGCndstF8ByqlmymadoRYMbh1kUhalvDZavSYE1gv-IrHC_Bp5FhR7Rimw9UaRu7n0J-uyj4sH4DLUtev05an5YmKH8jK86MkM0xHd7c--byzcHNLxd_Vz8SoBqvFf2wNgpV6AuQnyPD8y_nZnO4kCRbI0pnhDIfEef-gZ6qLP1anczOupTJEeo_P9yuxr6ThVaTiCCSz4Q-mf6SfXd3QTskw15i34NtGYtiOv7eF-ab4a_x4PC1-cSAofw/4vr/1SM4yMCdTRyo1xXpdCpPbA/h0/h001.astXZlMKGkQK6Cuv9XDPx0mfpqH0Uyb6YeR_IoT9-x0)** Congress handed ICE and Customs and Border Protection a blank check, enough to keep mass deportations running for years. ICE is now the highest-funded federal law enforcement agency in the country.1 That's our money. While working families stretch every paycheck to cover groceries, rent, and child care, billions of our tax dollars are going to raids, to warehouses turned into detention centers, and to private prison companies cashing in on every bed they fill.1 And the harm doesn't stop at the detention center door. When parents are afraid to take their kids to school and workers are afraid to show up for their shifts, our classrooms, hospitals, and local businesses all take the hit. The people profiting from this are betting we'll stay quiet. But we've proven our power before. And together, we can push Congress to rein in immigration enforcement, hold ICE and CBP accountable, and deliver the only real solution to this chaos: a pathway to citizenship. **[Congress wrote this blank check, and Congress has the power to claw it back. clean_body: The private prison companies are already counting on it. | | | Peter, The day after the midterm elections, the head of the Department of Homeland Security posted a three-word message: "Deportations will continue." 1 That same day, CoreCivic, one of the two largest private prison companies running ICE detention, took a call with investors. The message: ICE's funding is locked in, enforcement is ramping back up, and they're encouraging the agency to buy more detention centers quickly.1 Congress handed ICE and Customs and Border Protection a blank check, enough to keep mass deportations running for years. ICE is now the highest-funded federal law enforcement agency in the country.1 That's our money. While working families stretch every paycheck to cover groceries, rent, and child care, billions of our tax dollars are going to raids, to warehouses turned into detention centers, and to private prison companies cashing in on every bed they fill.1 And the harm doesn't stop at the detention center door. When parents are afraid to take their kids to school and workers are afraid to show up for their shifts, our classrooms, hospitals, and local businesses all take the hit. The people profiting from this are betting we'll stay quiet. But we've proven our power before. And together, we can push Congress to rein in immigration enforcement, hold ICE and CBP accountable, and deliver the only real solution to this chaos: a pathway to citizenship.
